notes.canopy_deg: Modern IAF's cold start: the canopy's full opening about its aft hinge, measured on a side photo of an F-16AM with its canopy up (the frame's lower edge 32.7 deg over the sill's 2.5 deg, seen a little from ahead; Wikimedia Commons, F-16 Vipers NL Air Force Days 9320352297), matched on the Barak from the same camera (modern-iaf/tests/_canopy_shot.gd SHOT_FOV)
notes.receptacle: on the spine's centreline behind the canopy (T.O. 1F-16A-1 p. 1-79): read off the model, 0.9 m behind the canopy's aft end on the spine's top (inferred)
notes.rcs: front 1.2 m2: the F-16's average with Have Glass (National Interest quoting GlobalSecurity; public figures rough and disputed); side 5x and rear 2.5x the front (inferred: an aircraft's largest returns are from the side, Aerospaceweb); 0.5 m2 per loaded external station (inferred); docs/ai.md 15.2
notes.gear_limit: Flight data Real: gear damage above 300 KIAS / Mach 0.65 with the gear extended (T.O. 1F-16A-1 fig. 5-7; KIAS taken as KCAS), docs/damage.md 5.2
notes.drag_chute: no F-16 or F-35 has a drag chute: the flight never asks the flight model for one
notes: The F-16 family's base and the Barak itself (the 1998 type 100): everything else of the Barak is the original's type-code tables.
notes.original_model: the 1998 model file a variant's model replaces
notes.hud_3d: the 3D cockpit's HUD (tools/f16d/cockpit3d.py HUDS): the Block 50's
notes.cockpit_3d: the 3D cockpit (Extras Cockpit: 3D), the Barak's and the Sufa's: tools/f16d/cockpit3d.py from the FlightGear F-16
notes.course.empty_kg: the F-16D's empty weight, 18,900 lb (Wikipedia, F-16 specifications; modern-iaf/docs/training.md [^w-f16]), as the take-off missions
notes.course.takeoff_kt: 70 kt + 3 kt per 1000 lb (Falcon BMS forum, after the manual's charts; training.md [^bms]) at 20,000 lb (9,072 kg) and 48,000 lb (21,772 kg), linear between
notes.course.final_aoa_deg: 13 deg on final (T.O. GR1F-16CJ-1 section II, Normal landing, p. 2-23; modern-iaf/manuals f16/ch2/landing.typ)
notes.course.slow_kt: the high-AoA lesson's slow flight (inferred: well below the pattern's 300 kt, above the final's speed)
notes.course.corner_kt: the corner speed at 9 g, about 355 kt in the game (docs/guides/f16.md; the real jet about 330-350 kt)
